channel.title: Workloads on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Workloads on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Workload
item.description: This section describes how to create an application workload. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Refer to Parameter Description to set the parameters for the workload. Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: View Workload List
item.description: This section describes how to view the application workloads list. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workloads View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workloads View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Workloads in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Workload Details
item.description: This section describes how to view workload details. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workloads View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workloads View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Workloads in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Workload Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit workload information. You can edit the alias and description of a workload. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a created workload. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Recreate a Workload
item.description: This section describes how to recreate a workload. Warning This operation will delete and recreate all pods in the workload. Business in the workload will be interrupted until the new pods are created. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles.

item.title: Adjust the Number of Pod Replicas
item.description: This section describes how to adjust the number of pod replicas for a workload. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Workloads in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Stop Workloads
item.description: This section describes how to stop a workload. Warning This operation will scale the number of running pod replicas in the workload to 0, which will interrupt the business running in the workload. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles.

item.title: Roll Back Workload Settings
item.description: This section describes how to roll back workload settings. The system will generate revision records after workload creation or modification, which can be used to roll back workload settings. A maximum of 10 revision records can be retained. Warning This operation will recreate the workload according to the revision record selected by the user. The business running in the workload will be interrupted.

item.title: Edit Workload Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the settings of a created workload. After a workload is created, you can edit its update strategy, containers, storage, pod graceful termination, and pod scheduling rules. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Refer to the Parameter Description to set the workload parameters.

item.title: Generate Workload Template
item.description: This section describes how to generate a template based on an existing workload. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Workloads in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Delete Workloads
item.description: This section describes how to delete a workload. Warning This operation will delete the workload and all pods managed by it. The business running in the workload will be interrupted. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Application Workload Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles.
